transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Well, what really brought me in today is that my mind just won't stay on one thing anymore. I work as a jeweler, and lately, when I'm at the bench, I just jump from... well, from checking a customer email to looking at a saw mark on a piece I'm working on, to just some random noise outside. And then I look down and realize I've completely lost track of the whole work order. It's just getting really hard to focus on what I need to do.
Have you had this kind of trouble focusing since childhood, or is it something that only started recently?

No, it's definitely not something I've had since I was a kid. It's pretty recent. This whole... wired, out-of-control stretch really started right after I won an award at a jewelry show. It went on like that for about two weeks.
Before this recent period, have you ever had times in your life where you felt deeply down, sad, or lost interest in things for weeks at a time?

Well, actually... it's more like right now. These past couple weeks, I've been waking up with this heavy, hollow feeling. It's like the shine has just completely gone out of everything. I've even found myself just sitting in my truck and crying before going in to open the shop.
Are you still feeling that wired, fast-paced energy at the same time as this heavy sadness?

No, not really. That wired feeling... it stopped before this heavy sadness started. They haven't been happening at the same time. The fast-paced stuff was going on for those two weeks, and then it just sort of crashed into how I'm feeling right now.
With how heavy things have felt, have you had any thoughts of ending your life or that you would be better off dead?

Yeah, I have. It's... it's been happening a lot lately. I keep having these thoughts that my family, and even my clients, would just be better off if I wasn't around anymore. I don't have a plan to do anything or anything like that, but... it really scares me how often the thought just pops into my head.
Are you still able to work at your shop right now, or has this completely prevented you from working?

Well, I'm... I'm really struggling to keep up with it. I actually missed a major custom delivery recently. My shop records just got so disorganized that I had to tell people I'm not taking any new work for now. It's just too much. And my family has been checking on me a lot more, too... I guess they got worried about how far I've slipped from my usual routines.
